name: Prompt Library — Sharp Glassmorphism
description: Frosted-glass prompt gallery floating over a vivid animated gradient mesh — translucent panels, backdrop blur, and luminous gradient accents. Includes category filter chips (Writing, Code, Analysis, Image), live search, and a working copy-to-clipboard button on every card with a checkmark 'Copied!' state. Requires a colored backdrop behind the panel for the glass to read.
features: gradient primary accents and cyan glow dot
